description:
Rewrite four sections of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md based on design discussion:

§2.5 (Invocations and dispatch): replace 'streaming reprompt' partial-result language with return-handle-then-poll. Dispatch is a tool like any other; every tool returns synchronously. Async work surfaces via handles + await/check tool. Preserves cross-provider compatibility (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini all require matched tool_use/tool_result pairing at the wire).

§2.7 (Compaction): rewrite compactor as a dispatched subagent with constrained toolset (write_summary, mark_for_deletion). Removes the 'scoped to the branch's diff' special case — compactor now operates through the normal dispatch/merge protocol with no privileged position. Main agent branch is quiescent during compaction (awaiting the dispatch's tool_result, same as any other dispatch).

§3.1 (Disk as Bus): one sentence clarifying threads not processes behind the disk contract. Disk-as-bus is for inspectability and single-author discipline across parallel workers, not cross-process IPC.

§6 (Workflow): add pre_step / post_step / on_tool_return as hookable events.

New §2.11 (Retries and failures): commit before API call (snapshot is replayable), retry retryable errors inline, diagnostic subagent dispatched for unknown failures.

Context: all of the above came out of a design walkthrough with the user on 2026-04-21. The driving insight is the symmetry principle — dispatch and compactor and subagents should all flow through one primitive, not each have a special case.
title: Architecture spec: tighten streaming, compaction, hooks, retry
